Ashley (Sales): Lumina follow-up: they want SIG Q-by-Q evidence and a short cover note per question. deadline Friday EOD. can we coordinate?
Raj (Security): I'll own KMS, IAM, and network segmentation evidence. point me to the canonical storage.
Olivia (Eng): I'll pull runtime isolation screenshots, pod security policy exports, and TLS chain. prefer shared folder.
Maya (Legal): I'll review any vendor attestations for NDAs before we send. flag anything with customer PII.
Ashley (Sales): Use /shared/sigs/lumina_bank/ and paste copies here. filename convention: lumina_q{num}_{control}-v2-YYYYMMDD.zip
Chris (Solutions): POC notes: we already gave them egress flow logs and an alert sample. I have annotated screenshots ready.
Raj (Security): For Q13 (KMS rotation) send rotation-policy.pdf, rotation-audit.csv, and a short custody statement signed by SecOps. I will redact internal hostnames.
Olivia (Eng): Uploaded zip to S3: s3://redwood-sec-artifacts/lumina/q13/lumina_q13_kms-rotation-20240512.zip. contains rotation-policy.pdf, rotation-audit.csv, rotation-audit.log.
sec-bot: Reminder: SIG schema v2. Include control IDs in filenames. Docs: https://internal.redwood/sec/sig-v2
Maya (Legal): For data residency Q, include the policy excerpt and a hosted vs dedicated explanation. I'll check wording.
Ashley (Sales): Finance: can we approve a 1-month 50% POC discount for Lumina? need sign-off to include in outbound.
Raj (Security): Q21 (cert revocation): I can provide OCSP/CRL evidence and a short PKI ops note.
Olivia (Eng): Added sanitized kubectl snippet and runbook for private pod spin up.
Chris (Solutions): Plan: one zip per question, 1-line cover note, control-id in filename. I'll check technical accuracy.
Maya (Legal): I'll sign off on any legal phrasing before send.
Ashley (Sales): Timeline: triage today, assemble tomorrow AM, internal sign-offs by noon, deliver Friday EOD. Ping here with zips.
sec-bot: Audit: user Olivia uploaded 7 files to /shared/sigs/lumina_bank at 2024-05-12T14:22:10Z
Ashley (Sales): Thanks team — I'll paste the final zip and outbound email for review when ready. :thumbsup:
